items.html: And so it is found that the light that was now taken from these ten Ketarim in every single Partzuf — namely the Yechida, the Haya, the Neshama, and the Ruach in each of these Ketarim — is the secret of the supernal splendor that was taken from Adam HaRishon, and only the light of the Nefesh remained in those Ketarim. And this is the secret of the “soul of man” mentioned several times in the Torah.
